dataset: eval/smartsort/v1 (synthetic, seed 20261011, template families and merchants disjoint across train/val/test)

systems.R1: current categoryFor() and parseBankSms() as shipped in 1.1.0-rc.1
systems.R2: revised deterministic rules: Pakistan brand lexicon from train+val merchants only, generic Pakistani shop words, Indian-only brands removed
systems.M: hashed character and word n-gram multinomial logistic regression, int8 weights, trained on train, threshold tuned on val
systems.R2+M: R2 first; M suggests only when R2 returns Other and M confidence clears the validation threshold

gate_ship_gate.role: may only send a rule-rejected message to Review; never adds, never overrides OTP, failed, pending, or promo rejection

otp_policy: OTP rows are removed before any model sees them; the deterministic OTP rule decides alone
if_gate_fails: do not ship the model; ship R2 if it beats R1
